sourceGrids.heading: Index Precision Strategy
sourceGrids.sourceBody:
Term Length Protection Level Indexes Available If Market Is Up If Market Is Down
1-year term 10% buffer
 
S&P 500® Index
 
Russell 2000® Index
 
Nasdaq-100® Index
 
iShares® MSCI Emerging Markets ETF
 
EURO STOXX 50®
 Credits an annual predetermined trigger rate if the annual index return is positive or zero. Provides a level of protection with a buffer that absorbs the first 10% of negative index return.
Download Index Precision Strategy 1-Year Term (PDF)

sourceGrids.heading: Index Dual Precision Strategy Multi-Year or 1-Year Terms
sourceGrids.sourceBody:
Term Length Protection Level Indexes Available If Market Is Up If Market Is Down
1-year term
3-year term
6-year term		 10% buffer
20% buffer
30% buffer
 
S&P 500® Index
 
Russell 2000® Index
 
Nasdaq-100® Index
 
iShares® MSCI Emerging Markets ETF
 
EURO STOXX 50®

The S&P 500 Index, Russell 2000 Index and Nasdaq-100 Index are the only indexes available with multi-year terms. 		Credits a predetermined trigger rate if the index return is positive, zero, or negative and within the buffer. Negative index return equal to or within the buffer provides a positive credit of the trigger rate, but if it exceeds the buffer it provides a negative credit equal to the amount of negative index return in excess of the buffer.
Download Index Dual Precision Strategy (PDF)

sourceGrids.heading: Index Guard Strategy
sourceGrids.sourceBody:
Term Length Protection Level Indexes Available If Market Is Up If Market Is Down
1-year term -10% floor
 
S&P 500® Index
 
Russell 2000® Index
 
Nasdaq-100® Index
 
iShares® MSCI Emerging Markets ETF
 
EURO STOXX 50®
 Provides performance potential up to a cap. Provides a level of protection down to the -10% Floor, which means you assume the first 10% of negative index loss and no more.
Download Index Guard Strategy 1-Year Term (PDF)

sourceGrids.heading: Index Protection Strategy with Cap and Index Protection Strategy with Trigger
sourceGrids.sourceBody:
Term Length Protection Level Indexes Available If Market Is Up If Market Is Down
1-year term 100% protection from negative index returns
 
S&P 500® Index
 
Russell 2000® Index
 
Nasdaq-100® Index
 
iShares® MSCI Emerging Markets ETF
 
EURO STOXX 50®
 Credits performance potential up to a cap or an annual predetermined trigger rate depending on the strategy chosen, if the annual index return is zero or positive. No losses will occur due to negative index returns.
Download Index Protection Strategy with Cap and Index Protection Strategy with Trigger (PDF)
